english.notes:
(i) Regulation 51 provides a defence of due diligence.
(ii) The restriction in regulation 36A of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 shall not apply to the manufacture or assembly of a medicinal product where manufacture or assembly is in accordance with the terms and conditions of a UK marketing authorisation or a marketing authorisation issued by the competent authority of an EEA State in accordance with Directive 2001/83/EC relating to that product.
(iii) Regulation 36 creates alternative offence for manufacture, sale and importation of any investigational medicinal product without authorisation granted by a licensing authority.
